== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Kessel: Spice Mines - Extraction Facility (Errata)]] (<code>1240_55</code>, Virtual Block 4 slip 54), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. Drawn without the Episode I icon of the card underneath, which the changed slip covers; the game text is unchanged.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201), post p637956 by Aglets, 25 July 2011: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p637956
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “'''Dark Side:''' During your control phase, may use 1 Force to place a 'spice' card in owner's Used Pile. '''Light Side:''' If you occupy, may use 3 Force to place a 'spice' card out of play.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB4-54-Kessel_Spice_Mines_Extraction_Facility-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
